name: bundle-computed-require-far-from-env-harvest
note: A vendored bundle (pdfkit ships yarn-berry's cjs) with a lazy-global 'require(name)' computed loader and, far away in the same megafile, an unrelated env iteration. The dynamic-require + bulk-env token-exfil HIGH now requires the require and the harvest to be in proximity, so a bundler runtime's computed require does not corroborate an unrelated env read a bundle away. A computed require sitting right beside an env harvest still blocks. Regression guard for the deeper-corpus false-block fixes.
